compiled_state.title: Preplanning DD traceability adds a Validates Closure Check annotation so Closure Checks items are traceable to done definitions
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story

As a TPM writing done definitions during preplanning, I can use a `← Validates Closure Check:` annotation form to link a done definition to a `## Closure Checks` item — so closure-check coverage is traceable in the same pattern as SC coverage, and the SC Contradiction Check does not flag it as a violation.

## Done Definitions

- DD1: `plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md` updated at Phase H Step 2 (traceability section) — `← Validates Closure Check: "<quoted closure check text>"` annotation form documented alongside the existing `← Satisfies: "<quoted epic criterion>"` form
- DD2: SC Contradiction Check in preplanning SKILL.md Phase H updated — a done definition with `← Validates Closure Check:` is NOT flagged as a contradiction or orphaned annotation; it is treated as a valid traceability link to the `## Closure Checks` section
- DD3: One worked example added to preplanning SKILL.md showing the annotation form in context (a done definition that validates a Closure Check item, not a Success Criterion)

← Satisfies: "SC (adversarial F3): preplanning DD traceability extended to cover Closure Checks items"

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
